BData X — French Property Intelligence for AI Agents
Property intelligence API + MCP server for AI agents: energy performance, market value, environmental risks, socioeconomic context, and investment scores. Monetized per-request via x402 micropayments on Base mainnet.
BData X provides AI agents with instant French property intelligence. Each API call crosses five public French datasets: energy performance certificates (ADEME/DPE), real estate transactions (DGFiP/DVF), natural and technological risks (BRGM/Géorisques), commune-level socio-economic indicators (INSEE FILOSOFI), and address geocoding (BAN/IGN).
For each property search, the API returns matching DPE records enriched with:
Market value estimates (median EUR/m2 based on comparable transactions within 200m)
Environmental risk synthesis (flood, earthquake, radon, clay shrinkage, industrial hazards)
Socio-economic context (median income, poverty rate, income deciles)
InvestScore: proprietary investment scores (Rendement + Securite) for decision-grade analysis
Ideal for autonomous AI agents in real estate investment, insurance underwriting, credit scoring, property valuation, and real estate tokenization.
MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
BData X provides an official MCP server that enables AI agents to query French property intelligence directly from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, and other MCP-compatible tools.
Installation: npx -y bdatax-immo-mcp
Available tools:
investscore(adresse: string, loyerM2Mois?: number) — returns investment scores (Rendement + Securite) with DPE, market value, and risk analysis
dpe(adresse: string | cp: string) — returns full DPE data with enrichments
The MCP server handles x402 payments automatically. Each tool call costs about 0.01 USDC for basic DPE queries or about 0.02 USDC for InvestScore analysis.
Registry: Official MCP Registry - io.github.benliberte/immo v0.1.2
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/bdatax-immo-mcp
Machine-readable specs
OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://dpe.bdatax.com/openapi.json
x402 discovery: https://dpe.bdatax.com/.well-known/x402.json
Endpoints
GET /dpe
Search DPE records enriched with DVF + Georisques + INSEE. Query by cp, adresse, voie, numero, ville, numeroDPE, lat/lon, or identifiantBAN. Returns JSON, CSV, or XLSX via ?format=.
Cost: about 0.001 USDC per call
GET /dpe/score
Investment analysis endpoint returning proprietary scores:
RendementScore (0-100): rental yield potential based on market value, energy performance, and local demand
SecuriteScore (0-100): investment safety based on environmental risks, market liquidity, and socioeconomic stability
Confidence level and detailed breakdown
Cost: about 0.02 USDC per call
Example API Calls
GET /dpe?cp=75001 — DPE in Paris 1st arrondissement
GET /dpe?adresse=203 rue Saint-Honore 75001 Paris — free-form address search
GET /dpe?lat=48.864968&lon=2.331665 — GPS coordinates
GET /dpe?numeroDPE=2175E0465600P — direct DPE ID lookup
GET /dpe/score?adresse=20 rue de la Republique 42000 Saint-Etienne — investment scores
Response Fields
Each /dpe result includes: numeroDPE, adresse, codePostal, codeInsee, surfaceM2, etiquetteDPE (A-G), etiquetteGES (A-G), coutAnnuelTotal, latitude, longitude, and three enrichment blocks:
dvf — { prixMedianM2, prixEstimeTotal, nbTransactionsComparables, derniereTransaction, rayonMetres, ecartSurfacePct }
georisques — { commune, codeInsee, risquesNaturels, risquesTechnologiques, nbRisquesPresents, sourceUrl }
insee — { revenuMedianNiveauVie, tauxPauvrete, decile1, decile9, rapportInterdecile, partSalaires, partRetraites, nombreMenages, nombrePersonnes, source }
The /dpe/score endpoint returns:
scores.rendement (value, grade, label)
scores.securite (value, grade, label)
property (surface, dpe, prixM2)
confidence level
sources used
All enrichment blocks return null when data is insufficient. The API is honest about uncertainty rather than guessing.
Payment Technology
Protocol: x402 v2 (HTTP 402 Payment Required extension by Coinbase)
Blockchain: Base mainnet (Ethereum L2)
Asset: USDC - contract 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
No account required: payment signed automatically by x402-compatible clients
Client libraries: x402-fetch (Node.js), x402-axios
Data Sources (Open Data / Licence Ouverte)
ADEME DPE (10.4M records): https://data.ademe.fr
DGFiP DVF (1.67M transactions 2024-2025): https://www.data.gouv.fr/fr/datasets/demandes-de-valeurs-foncieres-geolocalisees/
BRGM Georisques: https://www.georisques.gouv.fr
INSEE FILOSOFI 2021: https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/7756729
IGN BAN (geocoding): https://adresse.data.gouv.fr
